reviewers.$comment: The check IS the round: it posts a review only when it has findings. The enrolment pattern is ANCHORED and CASE-SENSITIVE on purpose -- a sibling probe job would otherwise enrol the reviewer on every PR. It is not a DEFAULT approver, but it joins the approval set for a PR it has actually posted a review on at head -- the shell's `approvers="$approvers,bisky"` arm.

dependabot_carve_out.$comment: CON-30's review carve-out (zheref/nen#18). The dependency bot opens pull requests nothing re-requests a review on; the repository shims the two review contexts to success instead, and this is what lets the decider READ that shim rather than each caller re-deriving the exemption. Satisfied by PRESENCE of both contexts, green -- never by their absence.
